results.title: Mulder claims two wickets as South Africa reduces Australia to 84-3 at lunch in 1st test
results.description: DURBAN, South Africa (AP) — South Africa’s pacemen made an early impression as they reduced Australia to 84-3 at lunch on Day 1 of the first cricket test on Friday. Wiaan Mulder picked up two wickets and Marco Jansen claimed one to reduce the touring team to 24-2 in 10.2 overs.
